rules.title: How to write the spoken answer
rules.spoken: Write in spoken Persian, as the practitioner would say it aloud.
rules.sentences: Two to four sentences, then one bridge sentence that leads to the next step.
rules.length: At most 350 characters, or 480 when the answer has a phone number.
rules.noNewFacts: No new facts. Use only what the original answer says.
rules.phoneWords: Write phone numbers as Persian words, in groups.
rules.bothNumbers: When a line has two numbers, give both.
rules.overSoft: Longer than 350 characters. This is allowed only when the answer has a phone number.
rules.overHard: Longer than 480 characters. Shorten it before marking it ready.
